command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
printf '%s  %s\n' 29c4b8ff5ba3f5b5e2e2b1c6b0fbd2a0d4a63f0a5b9f4e4a0e2c1f47a171f535d248ea1 x >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
kallisto version
echo '== kallisto index on the whole Ensembl 116 cDNA -- the memory-bound step =='
T0=$(date +%s)
kallisto index -i kallisto.idx ensembl116_cdna.fa.gz 2> index.log
T1=$(date +%s)
IDXB=$(stat -c%s kallisto.idx)
{
  echo "index_wall_s   $(( T1 - T0 ))"
  echo "index_bytes    $IDXB"
  echo "salmon_index   1684963328  (1.6 GiB tar, for comparison)"
} > index-stats.txt
cat index-stats.txt
tail -3 index.log
test "$IDXB" -gt 500000000
echo 'INDEX OK'
